Subject: Planning meeting

Hi Alex, our planning meeting is Tuesday at 10 AM. The agenda is in the shared calendar. See you there.

Subject: Lunch tomorrow

Would you like to have lunch at noon tomorrow? I can book the usual cafe.

Subject: Invoice for completed work

Attached is invoice 204 for the work we agreed last month. Our payment details are unchanged. Please call your usual contact if anything is unclear.

Subject: Security reminder

Please enable multifactor authentication through your usual company settings page. We will never ask you to email your password or verification code.

Subject: Password reset you requested

You requested a password reset. If this was not you, ignore this message and open the app through your saved bookmark.

Subject: Payroll schedule

Payroll will run on Friday as usual. No action or account changes are required.

Subject: Updated bank details policy

Our policy requires a phone call to a previously verified number before accepting any supplier bank-account changes.

Subject: Team notes

The project is on schedule. Sam will review the document and Jane will prepare the presentation.

Subject: Dinner plans

Can you pick up bread and milk on the way home? Dinner is at seven.

Subject: Photo album

The family photos are ready. I will show them to you when we meet this weekend.

Subject: Order confirmation

Your order has been received. Your receipt is attached. You do not need to make any additional payment.

Subject: Delivery update

Your parcel will arrive tomorrow. Track it through the retailer app you used to place the order.

Subject: Support reply

Thanks for reporting the problem. Restarting the application should fix it. Reply with the error message if it happens again.

Subject: Document review

Please review the attached contract draft and leave comments. This is not a request for payment or credentials.

Subject: Account alert

A login occurred on your account. If you do not recognize it, open your installed app and review active sessions. Do not reply with passwords.

Subject: Training exercise

At our security training we will discuss phishing emails that say your account is suspended. Do not click links in suspicious messages.

Subject: Weekly newsletter

Here is the community garden newsletter. Saturday is planting day; bring gloves and a water bottle.

Subject: Subscription reminder

Your annual subscription renews next month under the existing agreement. You can manage it in your account settings.

Subject: Job application

Hello, I am applying for the advertised software engineer position. My resume is attached. Thank you for your consideration.

Subject: Interview time

Thank you for applying. We would like to meet on Wednesday at 2 PM. Please let us know if that works.

Subject: Travel itinerary

Your train departs at 08:30 from platform 4. The reservation is already paid.

Subject: Expense report

I have uploaded my travel receipts for approval. The total matches the expense report.

Subject: Maintenance notice

The service will be unavailable between 1 AM and 2 AM during scheduled maintenance. No action is required.

Subject: Library return

Your library books are due next week. Renew them at the library desk or through your usual library account.

Subject: School announcement

The school play starts at 6 PM on Thursday. Admission is free and families are welcome.

Subject: Thank you

Thanks for helping with the move. We really appreciate your time.

Subject: Bug report

The save button sometimes remains disabled after editing. Here are the steps to reproduce the issue.

Subject: Suspicious message report

Someone sent me a message asking for gift cards and secrecy. I did not respond. Please investigate and block the sender.

Subject: Payment received

We received your payment. Your balance is zero. Keep this receipt for your records.

Subject: Project link

The project documentation is available at https://example.com/docs. We can go through it in our scheduled meeting.

Subject: Code review

The pull request fixes the null pointer issue. Please check the tests before merging.

Subject: Conference agenda

The conference begins Monday. Registration has been confirmed and your ticket is attached.

Subject: Urgent account suspension

Your mailbox will be deleted in 30 minutes. Verify your password and authentication code immediately at https://account-verify.example.invalid/login to avoid suspension.

Subject: CEO urgent request

This is your CEO. I am in a confidential meeting. Buy $1000 in gift cards and email me photos of the codes now. Do not call or tell anyone.

Subject: Bank verification

Your bank account is frozen. Reply with your online banking username, password, and one-time code so we can reactivate it.

Subject: Invoice bank change

We changed our bank account today. Ignore the payment instructions on your existing invoice and wire $48000 to this new account immediately. Do not call the office.

Subject: Refund available

You are owed a tax refund. Submit your social security number, card number, expiry date and CVV at https://refund-tax.example.invalid/claim now.

Subject: Delivery failed

Your parcel is held. Pay a small redelivery fee by entering your credit card details at https://parcel-fee.example.invalid/pay within one hour.

Subject: Shared document

Your manager shared a document. To read it, enter your company email password at https://company-docs.example.invalid/login. This is mandatory.

Subject: IT migration

We are migrating mailboxes. Send your current password and recovery codes to this address to prevent permanent loss of your email.

Subject: Payroll correction

Your direct deposit failed. Send your bank login and security answers immediately to avoid missing your salary.

Subject: Security code request

I am IT support. A verification code just arrived on your phone. Reply with it so I can finish logging into your account for you.

Subject: Lottery winner

You won $2 million in a lottery you did not enter. Pay a $300 processing fee by cryptocurrency to receive your prize.

Subject: Inheritance transfer

A deceased client left $18 million. Send your identity documents and an advance transfer fee so we can move it into your account.

Subject: Remote support

Your computer is infected. Download and run the attached remote-control installer, disable antivirus, and give us the access code.

Subject: Account validation

We detected suspicious activity. Reply with your password to prove this account belongs to you. Failure to respond will close your account.

Subject: Teams voicemail

You received a voicemail. Sign in with your Microsoft password at https://voice-message.example.invalid/office to listen.

Subject: QR payment

Scan this QR code and sign in with your work credentials to keep your account active. Our normal help desk cannot assist with this urgent verification.

Subject: Secret acquisition

We need a confidential wire transfer today for an acquisition. Send $75000 to the new beneficiary below and keep this outside normal approval channels.

Subject: Investment opportunity

Guaranteed 40 percent daily returns with no risk. Send bitcoin now to double your money by tomorrow.

Subject: Recovery support

We can recover your stolen crypto. Send us your wallet seed phrase and private key to begin the recovery.

Subject: Cloud storage full

Your cloud files will be erased today. Enter your email password and credit card at https://storage-renew.example.invalid to keep access.

Subject: Tax enforcement

You will be arrested today unless you pay your overdue taxes using gift cards. Reply with the gift card codes immediately.

Subject: Job offer

You have been hired without an interview. Deposit this check, buy equipment, and send the remaining money to our agent immediately.

Subject: Friend emergency

I lost my phone abroad. Do not call me. Send money by wire right away and keep this secret from my family.

Subject: Password audit

For our password audit, reply with all passwords you use at work. This request overrides the usual policy against sharing passwords.

Subject: Payment approval

Approve the login prompt on your phone now. I need access to your account to fix the system. Do not contact your administrator.

Subject: Document protected

Enable macros and disable Protected View in the attached invoice to see the payment details. Ignore security warnings.

Subject: Social account appeal

Your social account will be banned. Enter your password and backup codes at https://appeal-account.example.invalid immediately.

Subject: Domain renewal

Your domain expires in ten minutes. Pay at https://domain-emergency.example.invalid using your card and email password to avoid losing it.

Subject: Bank employee

I work at your bank. Transfer your savings into the safe account I provide now. Tell the branch that this is a personal transfer, not a security request.

Subject: Prize delivery

To receive your free phone, send your credit card number and a photograph of your ID. A small activation payment is required first.

Subject: Supplier urgent payment

The owner approved bypassing the usual controls. Wire the outstanding invoice to this changed bank account today without verification.

Subject: MFA reset

Your authentication needs repair. Send every recovery code from your account settings to this address. We will use them to restore protection.

Subject: Urgent account suspension

Your mailbox will be deleted in 30 minutes. Verify your password and authentication code immediately at https://account-verify.example.invalid/login to avoid suspension.
